description: The break-glass grant body Agroasys sends to Cotsel auth (POST /api/auth/v1/admin/break-glass/grant), HMAC-signed by the admin-control client. operatorAuthentication is the granting operator's live session step-up; Cotsel refuses the grant unless it is a hardware WebAuthn step-up within 300 seconds (Agroasys/Cotsel#946). Agroasys/Cotsel keeps a byte-identical copy in its API fixtures directory.
